title: Residential interiors
summary: From a single room to a complete home, we create interiors that balance personal expression with the practical rhythm of everyday life. Thoughtful layouts, natural materials, and layered lighting bring comfort and character together.
body: We begin with how you live: the mornings, the guests, the quiet corners. The design then works outward — layout, joinery, materials, lighting — until every room has a reason to be the way it is.
seo_description: Residential interior design in Lahore: space planning, material palettes, joinery and styling for homes that feel personal and calm.

title: Commercial spaces
summary: Welcoming workspaces, considered retail environments, and places where people connect. We shape commercial interiors around your brand, your team, and the people you want to welcome.
body: Commercial interiors have to work harder: they carry a brand, support a team, and still feel human at the end of a long day. We design for all three.
seo_description: Workplace, retail and hospitality interiors designed around brand, team and customer experience.

title: Bespoke woodwork
summary: Thoughtful joinery gives a space its quiet structure. From built-in storage to statement furniture, we develop timber-led designs that bring useful details and warm, natural character into your interior.
body: Bespoke joinery is where an interior becomes specific to its owner. We design pieces around exact measurements, daily habits, and the grain of the timber itself.
seo_description: Bespoke timber joinery, cabinetry and furniture designed for the exact room, routine and material.

title: Furniture & styling
summary: The right pieces make a room feel complete. We curate furniture, lighting, textiles, and objects into a coherent whole, mixing beautiful proportions with the comfort of a space that feels lived in.
body: Styling is the last 10% that makes a project feel finished. It is also the part most people find hardest to do on their own.
seo_description: Furniture, lighting, textile and art curation that finishes a room properly.

title: Interior renovation
summary: Reimagine what your existing space can be. We revisit layouts, refresh finishes, and develop a clear interior direction while respecting the features that make your property distinctive.
body: Renovation work is as much about restraint as addition. We keep what gives a property its character and change what no longer serves the way you live.
seo_description: Interior renovation that reworks layouts and finishes while keeping the character of the original space.

title: Design consultation
summary: Sometimes a thoughtful conversation is the best first step. Bring your floor plans, material ideas, or the room you cannot quite resolve. We help you identify priorities and outline a considered path forward.
body: A consultation is a working session, not a sales call. You leave with clear priorities, honest constraints, and next steps you can act on.
seo_description: A focused design consultation to resolve a room, set priorities and agree the next steps for your project.
